request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) expires on **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

What to do before then:

- **Attend the extension appointment** at the Ausländerbehörde on Wed 14 Oct 2026, 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. The letter says to bring original documents: passport, current enrolment certificate, proof of financing (e.g. blocked account, scholarship, or work contract with last 3 payslips), health insurance proof, a biometric photo, and your rental contract/landlord confirmation [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].
- **Pay the €100 fee** at the appointment, by girocard only (no cash) [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- **File the extension application before 30 Nov 2026** — the letter explains that if you apply on time, your stay is deemed to continue under § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG until a decision is made; without a timely application, lawful residence status ends when the permit expires [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- If you can't make the appointment, the letter says to cancel at least three business days beforehand [item:itm_5frk207bsfq1].
- The letter also notes a permit generally cannot outlast your passport's validity, so check your passport is valid long enough — this is only in the letter text, so worth double-checking against the paper letter [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].

Since this involves your residence status, if anything is unclear it's worth confirming directly with the Ausländerbehörde or an advisor.
